text:
erin: quick follow-up from the midnight surge — recurring low-sev pages from backlog replays. summary + owners.

erin: what happened: retry storms after DB transient caused hundreds of P4 alerts; dedupe missed because job_label was absent on many retries; routing sent pages to global-sre instead of queue owners.

erin: owners/actions:
- sam -> adjust alert thresholds and add derivative spike rule (due: Thu EOD)
- li -> dedupe fingerprinting (add job_label, error_signature) and extend window to 20m (due: Mon)
- nate -> routing map update so queue.* -> queue-owner, fallback to global-sre after 40m (due: Fri)
- priya -> runbook + circuit-breaker suppression for maintenance windows (due: Fri)

sam: i'll take thresholds. first pass: move latency cutoff from 30s -> 120s for backfill jobs and add a slope check so we don't hide real ramps.

li: dedupe plan: group by (cluster, job_label, error_signature), window 20m; will open PR #471 and test in staging.

nate: routing: will add mapping in routing-config, create canary targeting queue-east and include fallback after 40m as a soft page.

priya: runbook draft will include a circuit-breaker suppression when maintenance_tag==true; feature-flagged. sample rule: name=maint-suppress match="maintenance_tag==true && severity==P4" suppress_mins=360 notify=#obs-ops.

oncall-bot: created PM-8507 "Alert tuning: backlog replay noise" assigned to @sam @li @nate @priya — https://issues.redwood.example/PM-8507

erin: please drop a one-line update here as you make progress. i'll roll this into the remediation tracker before next ops sync.

sam: status: baseline collected; 95p for backfill = 102s; proposing 150s + derivative rule. will open PR tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

li: status: PR #471 opened. staging replay shows ~80% duplicate reduction. :construction:

nate: status: routing PR ready; canary scheduled Fri 22:00 UTC; fallback configured.

priya: status: runbook posted; FF staged; security review requested. link: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/backfill-noise

erin: plan: if staging looks good, prod flip Mon 03:00 UTC. i'll attach eval traces to Redwood Optimize to watch for false negatives after threshold changes.

sam: will add 25 traces to the Optimize eval set.

li: if duplicates persist above 20% after 1w, we'll tighten grouping further.

priya: once security approves, i'll enable FF in canary.

erin: final: update PM-8507 with prod flip status and close the ticket when all owners confirm. i'll add an incident signature to recurring-incidents (owner: erin) so detectors can match this pattern going forward.

nate: noted, will update ticket after canary and prod.

sam: will post verification here after prod. thanks team! :thumbsup:
